fullContentHtml:
SBI PO Pre Mains Result 2026 – Full Details

State Bank of India (SBI) has released the mains result for the recruitment of Probationary Officers on the official website. Online registration process for SBI PO Recruitment 2026 were accepted from from 18 June 2026, to 08 July 2026. There is a total of 1,500 vacancies has been issued in the SBI PO Recruitment 2026. The mains examination is going to conducted on 12 September 2026. Candidates who appeared this mains examination can download their SBI PO Mains Result 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 18 June 2026
  • Last Date : 08 July 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 08 July 2026
  • Pre Exam Training PET : 17 July 2026
  • Pre Exam Date : 01-02 August 2026
  • Pre Admit Available : 22 July 2026
  • Pre Result : 28 August 2026
  • Pre Score Card : 01 September 2026
  • Mains Exam Date : 12 September 2026
  • Mains Admit Available : 02 September 2026
  • Mains Result : 15 October 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 750/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 0/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is SBI PO Pre Mains Result 2026?

SBI PO Pre Mains Result 2026 is the official result announcement. Candidates can check their scorecard and merit status via the direct link above.

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
